systems.system: SIGE intégré des ministères des enseignements
systems.owner: the education ministries (ministères des enseignements), under the TRESOR programme agreed with the World Bank

note: Arrêté 803 of 18 April 2026 names an integrated SIGE only as the means of disbursement-linked indicator 6 (better availability of education data for decisions); it does not say what the system does or who enters data.
